summary.name: teampaper
summary.one_liner: A macOS screen recording and screenshot tool with built-in editing, notes, OCR text recognition, and file sharing via cloud links.
use_cases: share screenshots or videos via links
extract text from screenshots with OCR
collaborate with a team on captures with comments
summary.what_it_does: The page describes teampaper as a screen capture tool for macOS that records screen video or takes screenshots, with editing and notes. Captured media and files can be dragged onto the menu bar icon to upload them and get a separate link for each file. It includes an OCR text recognition feature. Captures can be organized into open, team, and private directories, with comments on shared items. The page also mentions cloud upload, saving to desktop, and copying to clipboard.
notable: Menu bar drag-and-drop upload that returns a link per file
Team and private directories with comments on shared captures
Listed as freeware in awesome-mac; also linked to a Mac App Store listing (Monosnap)
caveats: Requires Screen Recording permission, which can need to be re-added if it stops working
Some sync errors may need server recovery or contacting support
